cases.name: Invitation remains default and preserves legacy idempotency hashes without exposing a credential
Generated account logs in immediately and can keep using the same independent strong password
Native retries never return or replace an issued password; duplicate email cannot reset an existing identity
Separate accounts receive distinct random credentials and the correct portal/internal login scope
Admin authorization, organization/role boundaries and rejection of supplied password inputs remain intact
Only bcrypt hashes are stored; native receipts, audit and ordinary MCP redaction never expose the generated plaintext
MCP exposes only the opt-in first creation password; native retries and account reads cannot retrieve it
Generated accounts need no activation email; history stays safe and invitations cannot overwrite them
User may voluntarily change the generated password through the existing flow; old password then stops working
Every pre-existing identity retains its credential hash and normal login
